name: install_environment
description: make this agent's own environment once, before the first run: the package hoomd (HOOMD-blue) at the version conda-forge offered when the agent was built, with its Python, installed with pixi from conda-forge into runs/env; the runner points pixi's caches at runs/cache

python.description: the path of the environment's interpreter, relative to this directory

version.description: the version of hoomd the environment holds, read from its conda-meta record

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call
